assumptions: Object real, on the axis, 40 cm in front

notes: Base: 1/d_i = 1/12 - 1/40 = 7/120, d_i = 17.142857 cm. Object moved to 55 cm (TF6A6, TD4A9): 1/d_i = 1/12 - 1/55 = 43/660, d_i = 15.3488 cm. Object height (T60D5, T9757) belongs to the system and enters the magnification relation h_i/h_o = -d_i/d_o but not the image distance; I classify it C (it could arguably be called D for the image-distance target, since height never enters the thin-lens equation). Microphone stand and desk fan stand (T9D31, TD2E0) have no optical path to the image: D. Variant groups share numbers and units: {T60D5, T9757} 4 cm; {T9D31, TF6A6, TD4A9, TD2E0} 15 cm. For the 'then pushed' sentences I read the question as asking for the image after the push; this is the natural reading. 'Upright arrow' in T9757 is harmless.
